summary: Iter58 — Full verification of 9 V3Cube category pages wired to new public catalog endpoint /api/phase2/catalogs/{collection}. Backend pytest 14/14 PASSED. Frontend UI 9/9 routes return correct data-testid, correct item counts (beauty=5, pet=5, car-care=6, towing=4, nearby=6, services=6, all-services=6, carpool=5, marketplace=7), category chips render with correct testids, click interactions trigger expected toasts, /marketplace/cars navigation works, /towing has 4 'Appeler' buttons per card, admin non-regression (/admin/banners) confirmed working.
critical_code_review_comments: ServiceListLayout.js JSDoc comment says it 'Reads any /api/admin/crud/{collection} resource' but the implementation actually fetches /api/phase2/catalogs/{collection} — fix the comment to avoid confusion.

CarPoolPage.js publish-trip-btn currently shows toast.info('Publication de trajet bientôt disponible') — feature is announced in UI as 'Publier un trajet' but not yet implemented; consider hiding the button or wiring it to a POST endpoint.
MarketplacePage card click does toast.info(title) only — no detail page navigation; product owner should confirm this is the intended placeholder behavior for the catalog phase.

PUBLIC_CATALOGS endpoint uses a fixed whitelist (good) but returns ALL items via .limit(100) without pagination; if seeds grow, add ?limit=&skip= query support — currently limit param exists but no skip.
Google Maps Autocomplete deprecation warnings still appear (unchanged from iter57). Not a regression but should migrate to PlaceAutocompleteElement.
test_credentials: test2@example.com / TestPass123! (user), admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123! (admin). Email login UI on /login is phone-first — use POST /api/auth/login to set session cookie.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing startup-seeded data (auto-created when collection empty). Curl-verified counts before testing: beauty_salons=5, pet_providers=5, car_services=6, towing_partners=4, nearby_businesses=6, ondemand_services=6, carpool_trips=5, marketplace_listings=7.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter58 verified the new /api/phase2/catalogs/{collection} endpoint and 9 wired category pages. Endpoint is PUBLIC (no auth required) with whitelist PUBLIC_CATALOGS (8 collections). Unknown or non-whitelisted collection (e.g. 'users') → 404. Pages tested via mobile viewport 390x844. Login via API POST /api/auth/login because /login UI is phone-first. Toast verified on beauty card click ('Réservation envoyée chez X'), carpool publish-trip-btn ('Publication de trajet bientôt disponible'). Marketplace category navigation works: /marketplace → /marketplace/cars filters to 2 listings. Admin login + /admin/banners non-regression OK (shows 3 banners). No new bugs introduced.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature addition only, no bug. All 8 new public seed collections were auto-created at backend startup (verified counts via curl); generic ServiceListLayout + per-page components correctly bind to /api/phase2/catalogs/{collection} with credentials:'include'.
